content:
Speed = \(600/40 = 15\) m/s.

20 minutes = 1200 s, so bridge length:
\[
15 \times 1200 = 18000\text{ m}
\]

Total distance to completely cross the bridge:
\[
600 + 18000 = 18600\text{ m}
\]

Time:
\[
\frac{18600}{15}=1240\text{ s}=20\text{ min }40\text{ s}
\]

\boxed{20\text{ minutes }40\text{ seconds}}
